scoring_justification: Structural features (critical temperature, metastable region boundaries, bimodality) can be recomputed from raw CSV data and compared to paper-reported reference values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for canonical critical temperature, low-energy potential, microcanonical metastable boundaries, and trace bimodality thresholds
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 1, Fig. 3, and associated text
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper narrative: Tc=15.5, low-energy Φ≈–60, microcanonical region boundaries E=–25.6525 and E=15.2448, bimodal separation >5 and each peak >5%.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported quantitative claims and figures.

outputs.description: Canonical caloric curve data. The checker will recompute derived quantities (e.g., temperature of steepest jump, low-temperature energy) and compare against hidden paper-reported values.
Microcanonical caloric curve data. The checker will verify the existence and boundaries of a negative specific heat region (where dT/dE < 0).
Time series at fixed energy. The checker will compute a histogram of potential energy and verify a bimodal distribution with two well-separated peaks.

output_contract.notes: All output files are CSV with a header row. The checker will recompute structural features from the raw data, not trust self-reported metrics. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
